guard: The turn relay on the REAL manager serializes two turns on one seat at the dispatch (cotal-lang 6.5): the seat is shown the oldest unsettled turn alone, and the next one only once it yields.
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config bin/smoke/mutations/lang-spawn-live.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd
why: The suite runs the manager from its built package (the script builds `cotal-ai...` first), so
a mutation on manager `src` is seen through that build and `afterRestore` rebuilds so the
restored source is the artifact again. One mutant, aimed at the one line the serialization is.

mutations.name: every pending turn on a seat is served at once
mutations.expectRed: the seat is shown exactly one of them
mutations.cell: the seat is shown exactly one of them
mutations.note: The manager shows a seat one turn at a time (cotal-lang 6.5 at the dispatch, mirrored at the pull). Served all at once, a seat is asked for two turns together. Measured 2026-09-03 against the rebuilt manager (afterRestore builds before and after): exactly one named red (both turns shown); 32 passed, 1 failed.
